title.narrative: ''Green for Growth Fund (GGF), SICAV- SIF- Contribution for the Neigbourhood South countries.

description.narrative: The overall objective of the GGF is to help countries in the concerned regions to meet their targets for cleaner energy, reduce dependence on imported sources, increase energy security and support energy savings. For businesses and households this translates into increased industrial competitiveness and job growth, household comfort and costs and a less polluted environment.
